source_caption:
The original ending of Get Out (2017) was significantly darker, featuring Chris being arrested by real police officers rather than being rescued by his friend Rod. In this alternate version, Chris survives the violence but loses his freedom, deemed guilty of killing the Armitage family without anyone believing his story.

Director Jordan Peele changed this ending because it felt too hopeless for audiences, choosing instead to offer a moment of catharsis and triumph. The original, while not unrealistic, was deemed "too real" regarding the social commentary on injustice, leading to the triumphant theatrical ending where Rod rescues Chris.

source_details.synopsis: Get Out is a 2017 American psychological horror film written, co-produced, and directed by Jordan Peele in his directorial debut. It stars Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Lil Rel Howery, LaKeith Stanfield, Bradley Whitford, Caleb Landry Jones, Stephen Root, Catherine Keener, and Betty Gabriel. The plot follows a young black man (Kaluuya), who uncovers shocking secrets when he meets the family of his white girlfriend (Williams).
